entries.title: Psalms 12:1
segments: To the Chief Musician, on eight. A Psalm of David. Help, LORD, for the godly man ceases; for the faithful fail from among the sons of men.

entries.title: Psalms 12:2
segments: They speak vanity each one with his neighbor; [with] flattering lips and a double heart they speak.

entries.title: Psalms 12:3
segments: The LORD shall cut off all flattering lips, the tongue that speaks proud things,

entries.title: Psalms 12:4
segments: that has said, With our tongue we shall do much; our lips [are] our own; who [is] lord over us?

entries.title: Psalms 12:5
segments: For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, I will now arise, says the LORD. I will set in safety, he pants for it.

entries.title: Psalms 12:6
segments: The words of the LORD [are] pure words, [like] silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.

entries.title: Psalms 12:7
segments: You shall keep them, O LORD, You shall preserve them from this generation forever.

entries.title: Psalms 12:8
segments: The wicked walk on every side, when vileness is praised by the sons of men.
